Start with a reset, then keep it easy

Most Sachse homes we see fall into one of two camps: homes that need a top-to-bottom catch-up, and homes that are in good shape and just need to stay that way. We handle both.

Deep cleaning: the catch-up. Bathroom cleaning that cuts through soap scum and grout build-up, baseboard cleaning in every room, cabinet cleaning on fronts and handles (plus the inside of cabinets if they're empty), plus appliance cleaning inside the oven and fridge.

Recurring cleaning: the keep-it-easy part. Weekly, every other week or monthly. For a limited time, recurring clients get a reduced rate on every visit.

More ways we help in Sachse:

  • Pet-friendly house cleaning for homes with dogs and cats

  • Post-construction cleaning after a remodel

Our Sachse cleaning checklist

Kitchen: counters, backsplash, sink, stovetop, appliance exteriors, microwave and cabinet fronts

Bathrooms: toilets, tubs, showers, tile, mirrors, sinks and fixtures cleaned and sanitized

Every room: dusting, mirrors and glass, beds made, trash emptied

Floors: vacuumed and mopped throughout

Deep cleans add: spot-cleaned baseboards, ceiling fans, blinds, switch plates, window sills, cabinet fronts (plus the inside of cabinets if they're empty), soap scum and grout, and inside the oven and fridge; move-in/move-out cleans also add door frames, inside vanities and closet shelving

Pets are part of the family here too

Dog hair on the stairs and cat hair on the couch are just part of the job. We're pet-friendly, we use eco-friendly, pet-safe products, and we'll work calmly around your animals. Mention them in the booking form so we can plan for them.
